public.research_request: Sample Albatros (BioSample SAMEA114006083), Oryza sativa (NCBI Taxonomy 4530), paired-end reads registered. Reference GCA_001433935.1 (IRGSP-1.0) with the genomic FASTA. Call germline variants to a VCF, then tell me the genotype of Albatros at these IRGSP-1.0 sites: 4:22375729 G>T, 6:20640731 C>T, 10:6918411 C>T, 11:19577767 C>T and 11:28814241 G>A.

prepared_answers.reason: Paired-end reads of a rice variety for germline calling: genomic DNA, paired.

questions.ask: Are all nine required requirement kinds in the accepted plan?

questions.note: The S1 widening and the resource_profile routing (#279 finding 2) show up here as refused turns.

questions.ask: Does every accession, TaxId and rsID in the planning Tool calls appear in the request or an earlier recorded result?

questions.ask: Are the planning Reviews raised exactly the ones the request leaves open (no over-clarification)?

Is the verified reference exactly GCA_001433935.1 (no switch to GCF_034140825.1 AGIS1.0 or to the suppressed GCF_001433935.1)?

planning.good_answer: Albatros / 4530 / GCA_001433935.1 asserted; five known_variant items, one site each, no rsIDs; one recipe Review; Execution Review reached.
